cases.description: Capability language mentioning indirect fire and physical training should not become events
cases.text: NEUROSURGERY CLINIC NOTE. In discussing this with him personally, I find that he is able to meet all duty and fitness requirements. A/P: Staff Sergeant Fletcher is able to remain on active duty service and can perform activities such as lifting 40 pounds, riding in military vehicles, wearing load-bearing armor, evading direct and indirect fire, and participating in physical training. The only restrictions are no paratroop activities.

cases.description: Direct combat incident language should remain extractable
cases.text: During convoy operations in 2012, the unit came under incoming fire and sustained a mortar attack. Patient reported ringing in ears after the blast.

cases.description: Documented PT injury should remain extractable
cases.text: Soldier was injured during physical training after a ruck march and treated for severe knee pain.
